Test fixtures: small, unmodified (or line-sampled) excerpts of public datasets.
None contain executable content; they are event logs.

sysmon_t1548_find.log
    Splunk attack_data, datasets/attack_techniques/T1548/find/sysmon_linux.log
    https://github.com/splunk/attack_data  (Apache-2.0)

auditd_arp_cache.log
    OTRF Security-Datasets, datasets/atomic/linux/discovery/host/sh_arp_cache.zip
    https://github.com/OTRF/Security-Datasets  (MIT)

log4shell_sysmon.json, log4shell_auoms.json
    OTRF Security-Datasets, datasets/compound/Log4Shell/
      syslog_sysmon_log4shell_cve2021_44228_jndi_reference.zip
      syslog_auoms_auditd_log4shell_cve2021_44228_jndi_reference.zip  (MIT)

atlas_mini/
    680-line sample of ATLAS paper_experiments/S1 (CVE-2015-5122):
    every distinct attack-labelled line kind + 600 random benign audit lines
    + 30 browser lines, original order. Metadata files copied from
    testing_logs/S1-CVE-2015-5122_windows. https://github.com/purseclab/ATLAS
    (Apache-2.0). Alsaheel et al., "ATLAS: A Sequence-based Learning Approach
    for Attack Investigation", USENIX Security 2021.
